plan.summary: Add a REVERSE movement order that moves a vehicle one grid position opposite its current orientation without rotating it, while applying the existing boundary and simultaneous-collision rules.
steps: Add REVERSE to MovementOrder so turns can represent backward movement.
Add a position operation that calculates the adjacent coordinate opposite a vehicle's orientation.
Handle REVERSE in MovementEngine.applyOrder, preserving orientation and allowing the existing validity and collision-resolution pipeline to process the intended position.
Update the movement rules to list and define REVERSE, document its vectors and boundary behavior, and remove reverse movement from the out-of-scope section.
tests: Verify REVERSE moves a vehicle exactly one cell opposite each orientation while leaving its orientation unchanged.
Verify reverse movement beyond a board boundary is blocked.
Verify reversing into a stationary vehicle is blocked.
Verify reverse movements participate in same-target, position-swap, successfully-vacated-position, and dependent-chain collision rules.
Run the backend Maven test suite with ./mvnw test.
